# Juan Pablo Siachoque Campos

::: {.lede}
I am a PhD candidate in Economics at the **University of Nottingham**, on the
job market in 2026–27.

My research interests cover quantitative and applied labour economics, with a particular focus on search and matching in the context of informal employment. I also have research experience in fiscal policy and sovereign debt.

Before starting my doctorate I worked at the
[OECD](https://www.oecd.org/), the
[Inter-American Development Bank](https://www.iadb.org/en) and the
[Latin American Reserve Fund](https://flar.com/en/home/).
:::

### Research interests

- **Primary:** Labour economics — informality, search frictions, wage dynamics
- **Secondary:** Macroeconomics — fiscal policy and sovereign debt
